about.description: Versatile ASCII and ANSI Art text editor for drawing in the Linux/Unix/macOS terminal, with animation, 256 and 16 colors, Unicode and CP437, and customizable themes
about.head: 60ac05c

name: Durdraw 0.31.0
body:
0.31.0 changes:

Durdraw:
* New default mouse mode: Select (click and drag to draw selection area, or just click to move cursor)
* Animation brushes! (inspired by Deluxe Paint for Amiga)
    * To Make: Select -> New Brush -> Animation Brush
    * To Use: Mouse Tools menu -> Animation Brush (esc-t, a)
    * Frame preview appears under mouse cursor. Click to paste frame and advance to the next brush and canvas frames.
    * Loop mode Loops around existing frames
    * Clone mode clones current frame, pastes frame, and advances to next frame
    * In Animation Brush mode, alt-J goes to the previous and alt-K goes to the next frame in the brush
* Menu UI changes:
    * Main Menu renamed to File menu (esc-f or alt-f)
    * Edit menu moved to status bar (esc-e or alt-e)
    * Mouse Tools menu renamed to Mouse menu (esc-m or alt-m)
    * Settings menu moved to Edit menu
* Status bar UI changes:
    * Mouse mode (move/draw/etc) moved to bottom-right corner
    * Animation stuff (FPS, F:, D:, R:) anchored farther right, to make room for Edit menu
    * Frame Scrubbing: Hover mouse over F: area to change frames with scroll wheel
    * Hover mouse over FPS to change frame rate with scroll wheel (also during playback mode)
    * Hover mouse over F1..F10 characters to change character groups with scroll wheel
    * Removed |< and >| (first and last frame) buttons from the transport... I don't think anyone was actually using them?
* Insert mode (like a text editor): Toggle Insert mode with Insert key, or Edit -> Insert Mode
* Paste colors only (no characters) from the clipboard (Edit -> Paste Colors)
* Better mouse responsiveness
* New example art: tux-pizza, dur-welcome1, dur-welcome2, dur-welcome3
* Fire Behind effect now operates on existing frames, instead of making new ones
* Config file is now loaded in the following path order:
    /etc/durdraw/durdraw.ini
    ~/.durdraw/durdraw.ini
    ~/.config/durdraw/durdraw.ini
* Export menu added: ansi, ascii, gif, png, html, irc, json
* Help file updates:
    * Expanded User Interface section.
    * Added Mouse, Brushes and Animation Brushes  sections.
    * Added contributors and license
* Updated and expanded man page
* Various bug fixes

Durview:
* Stopped border, color picker and drawing character from flashing on the screen when durview is running
* Next and previous file commands "n" and "p" (Thanks @mevanlc!)
* 16colo.rs browsing filters by file extension (thanks again @mevanlc!)

Durfetch:
* Updated Arch animation, added some particle stuff
* New animation: linux-tux-pizza
* Fix for missing fields (DE, WM, GPU and Res) that broke in Fastfetch 2.68.1 (Thanks @tahuffman1s!)
